Primary Care Progress Note
Date: 09/01/2026
Patient: Agatha Carter, 77 y/o F

CC: Back pain

HPI: Back pain since 08/24/2026 after lifting a laundry basket. No radiculopathy or numbness reported. No bowel/bladder dysfunction.

PE: Tenderness over lumbar paraspinal muscles. No step-offs or deformities noted. ROM limited due to pain.

Assessment: Acute mechanical low back pain.

Plan: NSAIDs prn, activity as tolerated, follow-up in 2 weeks or sooner if worsens.
